skill.summary: Synchronize memory, preferences, and skills between multiple Clawdbot instances. Supports bi-directional sync via SSH/rsync over Tailscale. Use when asked to sync with another Clawdbot, share memory between instances, or keep multiple agents in sync. Triggers: /sync, 'sync with mac', 'update other clawdbot', 'share this with my other bot'.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: Bi-directional sync between Clawdbot instances via SSH/Tailscale
